description: Header file defining the MediaDecoder class for Android shared media decoding, including class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies.

classes.name: MediaDecoder
classes.description: Class managing media decoding on Android, handling input/output buffers, errors, and format changes, with threading and callback support.

classes.name: Host
classes.description: Interface for clients to receive notifications from MediaDecoder about output buffers, errors, format changes, and flushing.

methods.name: MediaDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MediaDecoder with either audio or video parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with an error callback.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the decoder.

methods.name: GetNumberOfPendingTasks
methods.description: Returns the count of pending tasks.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is properly initialized.
